newsitem.title: USA: Pharmacyclics gets approvable FDA letter.
newsitem.headline: Pharmacyclics gets approvable FDA letter.

text.p: Pharmacyclics Inc said it received a letter from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration indicating that the company's application for the use of Gadolite Oral Suspension is approvable, pending the submission of more information and final product labeling.
The company did not say what additional information it needed to submit. The drug has not yet received final FDA approval, the company said.
The drug is used as a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) contrast agent to enhance delineation of the bowel, the company said.
